question: What does the word 'prosper' most likely mean in the context of the story?
question_zh: 在故事中，'prosper' 一詞最可能的意思是什麼？
answer_en: To succeed and grow
answer_ja: 成功して成長すること
answer_local: To succeed and grow
explanation_zh: prosper 指的是成功並且發展茁壯。

question: What is the meaning of 'bargain' as used in the sentence 'Then our bargain is made'?
question_zh: 'Then our bargain is made' 中的 'bargain' 是什麼意思？
answer_en: An agreement
answer_ja: 合意
answer_local: An agreement
explanation_zh: bargain 在此指雙方達成的協議。

question: What does 'rid' mean in the phrase 'I can rid the town of all rats'?
question_zh: 'I can rid the town of all rats' 中的 'rid' 是什麼意思？
answer_en: To remove
answer_ja: 取り除くこと
answer_local: To remove
explanation_zh: rid 指的是清除或移除某物。

question: What does 'exploitation' mean in the sentence 'We have a duty to protect the citizens of Hanlon from exploitation'?
question_zh: 'We have a duty to protect the citizens of Hanlon from exploitation' 中的 'exploitation' 是什麼意思？
answer_en: Taking unfair advantage
answer_ja: 不公平な利用
answer_local: Taking unfair advantage
explanation_zh: exploitation 指的是不公平地利用他人。

question: What is the meaning of 'harvest' in 'A harvest lost can grow again'?
question_zh: 'A harvest lost can grow again' 中的 'harvest' 是什麼意思？
answer_en: The gathering of crops
answer_ja: 作物の収穫
answer_local: The gathering of crops
explanation_zh: harvest 指的是收割農作物的行為。

question: What does 'crisis' mean in 'The council is working day and night to solve this crisis'?
question_zh: 'The council is working day and night to solve this crisis' 中的 'crisis' 是什麼意思？
answer_en: A serious problem
answer_ja: 深刻な問題
answer_local: A serious problem
explanation_zh: crisis 指的是嚴重的問題或緊急狀況。

question: What does 'starving' mean in 'We're starving!'?
question_zh: 'We're starving!' 中的 'starving' 是什麼意思？
answer_en: Very hungry
answer_ja: 非常に空腹であること
answer_local: Very hungry
explanation_zh: starving 指的是非常飢餓。

question: What does 'destroyed' mean in 'They destroyed my grain stores!'?
question_zh: 'They destroyed my grain stores!' 中的 'destroyed' 是什麼意思？
answer_en: Ruined completely
answer_ja: 完全に破壊された
answer_local: Ruined completely
explanation_zh: destroyed 指的是完全毀壞。

question: What does 'traveler' mean in 'A traveler. And perhaps the solution to your problem.'?
question_zh: 'A traveler. And perhaps the solution to your problem.' 中的 'traveler' 是什麼意思？
options: A person who moves from place to place
A person who works in a shop
answer_en: A person who moves from place to place
answer_ja: あちこちを移動する人
answer_local: A person who moves from place to place
explanation_zh: traveler 指的是四處旅行的人。

question: 單字題目產生失敗（第 10 題）
question_zh: 單字題目產生失敗（第 10 題）
answer_en: A
answer_ja: A
answer_local: A
explanation_zh: 此題為保護性佔位，請重新產生題庫。

question: Which sentence is correct to express a future possibility?
question_zh: 哪一句是正確表達未來可能性的句子？
options: If any rat remains, you owe me nothing.
If any rat remained, you owe me nothing.
If any rat remain, you owe me nothing.
If any rat will remain, you owe me nothing.
options_zh: 如果有老鼠留下，你不欠我任何東西。
如果有老鼠留下，你不欠我任何東西。（過去式）
如果有老鼠留下，你不欠我任何東西。（錯誤用法）
如果有老鼠將會留下，你不欠我任何東西。（錯誤用法）
answer_en: If any rat remains, you owe me nothing.
answer_zh: 如果有老鼠留下，你不欠我任何東西。
answer_ja: もしネズミが残っていれば、あなたは私に何も支払う必要はありません。
answer_local: If any rat remains, you owe me nothing.
explanation_zh: 條件句中，現在簡單式用於表示未來可能性。

question: Choose the correct sentence using the past tense.
question_zh: 選出正確使用過去式的句子。
options: The rats ate half my bakery yesterday.
The rats eat half my bakery yesterday.
The rats eaten half my bakery yesterday.
The rats eating half my bakery yesterday.
options_zh: 老鼠昨天吃了我一半的麵包店。
老鼠昨天吃我一半的麵包店。（錯誤）
老鼠昨天吃過我一半的麵包店。（錯誤）
老鼠昨天正在吃我一半的麵包店。（錯誤）
answer_en: The rats ate half my bakery yesterday.
answer_zh: 老鼠昨天吃了我一半的麵包店。
answer_ja: ネズミが昨日、私のパン屋の半分を食べてしまいました。
answer_local: The rats ate half my bakery yesterday.
explanation_zh: ate 是 eat 的過去式，表示昨天發生的動作。

question: Which sentence correctly uses the modal verb to express ability?
question_zh: 哪一句正確使用情態動詞表達能力？
options: I can remove them every single one.
I may remove them every single one.
I must remove them every single one.
I should remove them every single one.
options_zh: 我可能移除他們每一隻。
我必須移除他們每一隻。
我應該移除他們每一隻。
answer_en: I can remove them every single one.
answer_ja: 私はそれらを一匹残らず取り除くことができます。
answer_local: I can remove them every single one.
explanation_zh: can 用來表示能力。

question: Which sentence correctly uses the phrase 'working day and night'?
question_zh: 哪一句正確使用 'working day and night' 這個片語？
options: The council is working day and night to solve this crisis.
The council works day and night to solve this crisis.
The council worked day and night to solve this crisis.
The council working day and night to solve this crisis.
options_zh: 議會正在日夜工作解決危機。
議會日夜工作解決危機。
議會曾日夜工作解決危機。
議會日夜工作解決危機。（錯誤）
answer_en: The council is working day and night to solve this crisis.
answer_zh: 議會正在日夜工作解決危機。
answer_ja: 議会はこの危機を解決するために昼夜働いています。
answer_local: The council is working day and night to solve this crisis.
explanation_zh: 現在進行式用於描述正在發生的動作。

question: Which sentence correctly uses the phrase 'If this continues'?
question_zh: 哪一句正確使用 'If this continues' ？
options: If this continues, Hamlin won't survive!
If this continue, Hamlin won't survive!
If this continued, Hamlin won't survive!
If this will continue, Hamlin won't survive!
options_zh: 如果這持續下去，Hamlin 不會存活。
如果這持續下去，Hamlin 不會存活。（錯誤）
如果這持續過去，Hamlin 不會存活。
如果這將持續，Hamlin 不會存活。（錯誤）
answer_en: If this continues, Hamlin won't survive!
answer_zh: 如果這持續下去，Hamlin 不會存活。
answer_ja: このまま続けば、ハムリンは生き残れません！
answer_local: If this continues, Hamlin won't survive!
explanation_zh: 條件句中，現在簡單式用於表示未來可能性。

question: Which sentence correctly uses the phrase 'You have our promise'?
question_zh: 哪一句正確使用 'You have our promise'？
options_zh: 你正在有我們的承諾。（錯誤）
answer_en: You have our promise.
answer_ja: 私たちの約束です。
answer_local: You have our promise.
explanation_zh: have 用於第二人稱複數表示擁有。

question: Which sentence correctly uses the phrase 'I will collect the payment'?
question_zh: 哪一句正確使用 'I will collect the payment'？
answer_en: I will collect the payment.
answer_ja: 私は支払いを集めます。
answer_local: I will collect the payment.
explanation_zh: will 用於表示未來的動作。

question: Which sentence uses the correct plural form?
question_zh: 哪一句使用了正確的複數形式？
answer_en: The rats were everywhere.
answer_ja: ネズミが至る所にいました。
answer_local: The rats were everywhere.
explanation_zh: rats 是複數，were 是複數動詞。

question: Choose the correct sentence using the past perfect tense.
question_zh: 選出正確使用過去完成式的句子。
options: The rats had eaten half my bakery before I arrived.
The rats ate half my bakery before I arrived.
The rats have eaten half my bakery before I arrived.
The rats eating half my bakery before I arrived.
options_zh: 我到達前老鼠已經吃了我一半的麵包店。
我到達前老鼠吃了我一半的麵包店。
我到達前老鼠已經吃了我一半的麵包店。（錯誤）
我到達前老鼠正在吃我一半的麵包店。（錯誤）
answer_en: The rats had eaten half my bakery before I arrived.
answer_zh: 我到達前老鼠已經吃了我一半的麵包店。
answer_ja: 私が到着する前にネズミはパン屋の半分を食べてしまいました。
answer_local: The rats had eaten half my bakery before I arrived.
explanation_zh: 過去完成式表示在過去某時間之前已完成的動作。

question: Which sentence uses the correct form of the verb 'to be' in past tense?
question_zh: 哪一句使用了正確的過去式 'to be' 動詞形式？
options: The town of Hamlin had a problem.
The town of Hamlin has a problem.
The town of Hamlin have a problem.
The town of Hamlin having a problem.
answer_en: The town of Hamlin had a problem.
answer_ja: ハムリンの町には問題がありました。
answer_local: The town of Hamlin had a problem.
explanation_zh: had 是 have 的過去式。

question: What was the main problem in the town of Hamlin?
question_zh: Hamlin鎮的主要問題是什麼？
answer_en: A rat problem
answer_ja: ネズミの問題です。
answer_local: A rat problem
explanation_zh: 故事中提到Hamlin鎮有嚴重的老鼠問題。

question: Who claimed to be able to remove all the rats from Hamlin?
question_zh: 誰聲稱能移除Hamlin鎮所有的老鼠？
answer_en: A traveler
answer_ja: 旅人です。
answer_local: A traveler
explanation_zh: 故事中有一位旅行者說他能移除所有老鼠。

question: What was the payment demanded by the traveler for removing the rats?
question_zh: 旅行者要求移除老鼠的報酬是多少？
answer_en: 1,000 gold coins
answer_ja: 1000枚の金貨です。
answer_local: 1,000 gold coins
explanation_zh: 旅行者要求1000枚金幣作為報酬。

question: What happened after the traveler played his tune?
question_zh: 旅行者吹奏曲子後發生了什麼事？
options: The rats hid in the church.
answer_en: The rats left the town.
answer_ja: ネズミは町を去りました。
answer_local: The rats left the town.
explanation_zh: 旅行者吹奏後，老鼠離開了鎮上。

question: How did the people of Hamlin respond to the traveler's demand for payment?
question_zh: Hamlin鎮的人們如何回應旅行者的付款要求？
options: They refused to pay 1,000 gold coins and offered 50 instead.
They asked for a lower price.
options_zh: 他們拒絕支付1000枚金幣，改付50枚。
answer_en: They refused to pay 1,000 gold coins and offered 50 instead.
answer_zh: 他們拒絕支付1000枚金幣，改付50枚。
answer_ja: 彼らは1000枚の金貨を支払うことを拒み、代わりに50枚を提示しました。
answer_local: They refused to pay 1,000 gold coins and offered 50 instead.
explanation_zh: 他們認為1000枚金幣太多，只願付50枚。

question: What did the traveler say he would do if the town failed to pay him?
question_zh: 如果鎮上沒付錢，旅行者說他會怎麼做？
options_zh: 他不會向他們索要任何東西。
answer_en: He would owe them nothing.
answer_zh: 他不會向他們索要任何東西。
answer_ja: 彼は彼らに何も借りていません。
answer_local: He would owe them nothing.
explanation_zh: 如果有老鼠留下，他不會收錢。

question: What was the council's decision about the traveler's payment?
question_zh: 議會對旅行者的付款決定是什麼？
options: To refuse to pay the full amount and let him go.
To pay the full amount immediately.
options_zh: 拒絕支付全額並讓他離開。
answer_en: To refuse to pay the full amount and let him go.
answer_zh: 拒絕支付全額並讓他離開。
answer_ja: 全額の支払いを拒否して彼を解放すること。
answer_local: To refuse to pay the full amount and let him go.
explanation_zh: 議會決定不付全額並放他走。

question: What happened to the children at the end of the story?
question_zh: 故事結尾孩子們發生了什麼事？
options: They disappeared with the Piper and never returned.
They were saved by the town.
options_zh: 他們跟著吹笛人消失再也沒回來。
answer_en: They disappeared with the Piper and never returned.
answer_zh: 他們跟著吹笛人消失再也沒回來。
answer_ja: 彼らは笛吹き男と共に姿を消し、二度と戻りませんでした。
answer_local: They disappeared with the Piper and never returned.
explanation_zh: 故事中孩子們跟著吹笛人消失了，沒有回來。

question: What lesson does the story suggest about trust?
question_zh: 故事對信任提出了什麼教訓？
options: Trust, once broken, may cost far more than anyone is willing to pay.
options_zh: 信任一旦破裂，代價可能遠超過任何人願意付出的。
answer_en: Trust, once broken, may cost far more than anyone is willing to pay.
answer_zh: 信任一旦破裂，代價可能遠超過任何人願意付出的。
answer_ja: 一度壊れた信頼は、誰も払いたくないほどの大きな代償を伴うことがあります。
answer_local: Trust, once broken, may cost far more than anyone is willing to pay.
explanation_zh: 故事強調信任破裂的代價很大。

question: What did the people promise to do if the traveler succeeded?
question_zh: 如果旅行者成功，人民承諾會怎麼做？
answer_en: Pay him 1,000 gold coins.
answer_ja: 彼に1000枚の金貨を支払うこと。
answer_local: Pay him 1,000 gold coins.
explanation_zh: 人民承諾如果成功會付1000枚金幣。

question: If you were a citizen of Hamlin, how would you feel about the traveler's demand for 1,000 gold coins?
question_zh: 如果你是Hamlin的居民，對旅行者要求1000枚金幣的報酬會有什麼感覺？
options: It is too expensive and unfair.
answer_en: It is too expensive and unfair.
answer_ja: それは高すぎて不公平です。
answer_local: It is too expensive and unfair.
explanation_zh: 故事中居民覺得1000枚金幣太貴且不公平。

question: Why do you think the traveler returned at the end of the story?
question_zh: 你認為故事結尾旅行者為什麼會回來？
options: To collect the payment owed to him.
answer_en: To collect the payment owed to him.
answer_ja: 彼に支払われるべき報酬を回収するため。
answer_local: To collect the payment owed to him.
explanation_zh: 故事中旅行者說他會回來收錢。

question: What can be inferred about the town's trust in the traveler after the children disappeared?
question_zh: 孩子消失後，可以推斷鎮上對旅行者的信任如何？
options: The trust was broken and lost.
answer_en: The trust was broken and lost.
answer_ja: 信頼は壊れて失われました。
answer_local: The trust was broken and lost.
explanation_zh: 孩子消失象徵信任被破壞。

question: Why might the people have only offered 50 gold coins instead of 1,000?
question_zh: 為什麼人們只願意付50枚金幣而不是1000枚？
options: They thought 1,000 was too much and unfair.
They didn't have any gold coins.
They wanted to trick the traveler.
They didn't believe the traveler could help.
options_zh: 他們覺得1000太多且不公平。
他們不相信旅行者能幫忙。
answer_en: They thought 1,000 was too much and unfair.
answer_zh: 他們覺得1000太多且不公平。
answer_ja: 彼らは1000は多すぎて不公平だと思いました。
answer_local: They thought 1,000 was too much and unfair.
explanation_zh: 他們認為1000枚金幣太貴且不公平。

question: What does the phrase 'Keep your gold' imply about the traveler's attitude?
question_zh: 'Keep your gold' 這句話暗示旅行者的態度是什麼？
options: He is confident and determined to get what he deserves.
options_zh: 他自信且決心得到應得的報酬。
answer_en: He is confident and determined to get what he deserves.
answer_zh: 他自信且決心得到應得的報酬。
answer_ja: 彼は自信を持ち、自分にふさわしいものを手に入れる決意をしています。
answer_local: He is confident and determined to get what he deserves.
explanation_zh: 旅行者表現出自信並堅持要得到報酬。

question: What might be the moral of the story 'The Pied Piper of Hamlin'?
question_zh: 'Hamlin的吹笛人'故事的寓意可能是什麼？
options: Keep promises and be careful whom you trust.
options_zh: 遵守承諾並謹慎信任他人。
answer_en: Keep promises and be careful whom you trust.
answer_zh: 遵守承諾並謹慎信任他人。
answer_ja: 約束を守り、誰を信頼するか慎重になりましょう。
answer_local: Keep promises and be careful whom you trust.
explanation_zh: 故事提醒人們要守信用並謹慎信任。

question: If you were the mayor of Hamlin, what would you do after the children disappeared?
question_zh: 如果你是Hamlin的市長，孩子消失後你會怎麼做？
options: Organize a search and warn the citizens.
Ask the children to come back later.
answer_en: Organize a search and warn the citizens.
answer_ja: 捜索を組織し、市民に警告を出しましょう。
answer_local: Organize a search and warn the citizens.
explanation_zh: 市長應該組織搜救並警告市民。

question: What does the phrase 'Gold lost can be earned again' suggest about the town's recovery?
question_zh: 'Gold lost can be earned again' 這句話暗示鎮上的復原情況如何？
options: Material losses can be recovered over time.
options_zh: 物質損失可以隨時間恢復。
answer_en: Material losses can be recovered over time.
answer_zh: 物質損失可以隨時間恢復。
answer_ja: 物質的な損失は時間とともに回復できます。
answer_local: Material losses can be recovered over time.
explanation_zh: 物質損失是可以透過時間恢復的。

question: Why is the phrase 'A promise has value only when it costs something to keep' important in the story?
question_zh: 'A promise has value only when it costs something to keep' 這句話在故事中為何重要？
options: It shows that promises must be taken seriously.
It means promises are always free.
It means promises can be broken easily.
options_zh: 表示承諾必須被認真對待。
表示承諾可以輕易被打破。
answer_en: It shows that promises must be taken seriously.
answer_zh: 表示承諾必須被認真對待。
answer_ja: 約束は真剣に受け止めなければならないことを示しています。
answer_local: It shows that promises must be taken seriously.
explanation_zh: 這句話強調承諾需要付出代價才有價值。

question: What might be a reason the townspeople did not keep their promise to the traveler?
question_zh: 鎮民沒有遵守對旅行者的承諾可能的原因是什麼？
options: They felt the payment was too high and unfair.
options_zh: 他們覺得報酬太高且不公平。
answer_en: They felt the payment was too high and unfair.
answer_zh: 他們覺得報酬太高且不公平。
answer_ja: 彼らは報酬が高すぎて不公平だと感じました。
answer_local: They felt the payment was too high and unfair.
explanation_zh: 鎮民認為報酬過高且不公平，因此沒有遵守承諾。
